name: workspace-url-sign-in
title: Workspace URL sign-in
description: Sign in to a workspace by its address: your domain after the name, recent workspaces that skip the typing, and a way to find a forgotten one.
docs: domain is your product's domain, written after the field as .example.com. The field cleans what is typed or pasted: lower case, no spaces, only letters, digits and hyphens, and a whole address such as https://Acme.example.com/login leaves acme (cleanWorkspaceSlug is exported from workspace-url-sign-in/slug). Enter submits. onContinue(slug) returns an error message or nothing: a message (it may contain {address}, filled with the address that was tried, acme.example.com) is announced against the field, which keeps the value, selects it and takes the focus; nothing means go, and that is where you navigate. A throw shows a general message. recent is { slug, name, logo? }[]: each row is a button that skips the typing and shows busy while it opens; in a card narrower than 22rem the hover arrow of a row is dropped, so the address has the room. onRemoveRecent adds a remove button per row that turns the row into a question (Remove Northwind Studio from this device?) with Keep focused and Escape to cancel; resolve and drop the item from recent and the focus moves to the next row. onFindWorkspace adds Forgot your workspace address? for an email lookup. defaultSlug, defaultError and defaultConfirming set the start for previews; footer, titleAs and labels work as in the other auth cards.
